shared_elements: carved stone surface in low relief
circle or disc motif (raised boss in A; round shields in B)
museum interior display against a wall
justification: Both are eroded stone reliefs displayed indoors and both include round disc-like forms, but that is essentially where the correspondence ends. A is a tall, free-standing block with a few large, deeply rounded and abstracted motifs stacked vertically, while B is a wide horizontal frieze of finely incised, narrative figural scenes with architecture read left to right — utterly different in format, density and carving technique.
